Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: An expense entry representing a shared cohabitation cost or payment ledger item.

title.description: A brief description/title of the expense.

amount.description: The total Euro amount of the expense.

paidBy.description: The roommate who initially paid for the expense.

splitType.description: How the cost is divided between roommates.

timestamp.description: Server-generated timestamp when the expense was logged.

isCoin.description: Whether this log is for physical electricity meter coin insertion.

isSettlement.description: Whether this is a settle-up balance transfer entry.

isLendBorrow.description: Whether this is a lend/borrow direct cash or transfer entry.

paymentMethod.description: The transfer mode used for the lend/borrow transaction.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: Roommate security profile storing encrypted or hashed password and custom preferences.

password.description: The password used to access and secure this profile.

expenses.description: The primary collection storing all ledger items, electricity coin logs, and settlements.

profiles.description: Security profiles for Ozric and Pawan.
